candidates.name: Cory Booker
candidates.basis: Backs Medicare for All, $15 wage, Green New Deal, DACA; liberty mixes pro-choice and legalization with gun licensing; backed vouchers as mayor.

candidates.name: Justin Murphy
candidates.basis: Wants tax and spending cuts, border security, tougher China stance, parental rights; opposes offshore wind and recreational marijuana (sole liberty evidence).

candidates.name: Ben Ray Luján
candidates.basis: Co-sponsored Medicare for All and Green New Deal, opposes vouchers, backs net neutrality, pathway for Dreamers; liberty lifted by background-check support.

photo.file: File:Ben Ray Luján, official portrait (119th Congress) (cropped)1.jpg
photo.author: Rosa Pineda, U.S. Senate

candidates.name: Larry Marker
candidates.basis: Describes himself as pro-life (sole liberty evidence); backs Trump immigration policies, oil and gas, looser regulations; criticizes welfare programs; campaigns on Christian faith.

candidates.name: Deb Haaland
candidates.basis: Plans public health option, universal childcare, higher minimum wage, more renewables; backed Green New Deal, assault weapons ban (liberty driver), opposes vouchers.

candidates.name: Gregg Hull
candidates.basis: Would eliminate income tax, produce more oil, adopt zero-tolerance policing, invest in public schools; opposes any gun ban (sole liberty evidence).

candidates.name: Bruce Blakeman
candidates.basis: Would cut income taxes, repeal cashless bail, cooperate with ICE, join private-school scholarships; blames offshore wind for bills; liberty: pro-choice, transgender-athlete ban, mask ban.

candidates.name: Kathy Hochul
candidates.basis: Signed RAISE AI-safety act and gun restrictions (liberty driver); pro-choice; pursues universal childcare; opposes vouchers and state help for federal immigration raids.

photo.file: File:Governor Hochul Announces Five-Point Plan to Protect New Yorkers on the Subway (cropped 4).jpg
photo.author: Marc A. Hermann / MTA

candidates.name: Roy Cooper
candidates.basis: Expanded Medicaid, vetoed voucher expansion and ICE-cooperation mandate, set emissions-reduction targets, backs Ukraine, would roll back tariffs; liberty: pro-choice, moderate on guns.

candidates.name: Michael Whatley
candidates.basis: Backs tax cuts, deporting criminal noncitizens, ending cashless bail, expanded energy production; pro-life, pro-Second Amendment, opposes transgender women in women's sports.

candidates.name: Sherrod Brown
candidates.basis: Backs higher taxes on wealthy, tariffs, $15 wage, climate action, DACA; opposes vouchers and Patriot Act renewal; liberty mixes pro-choice with assault-weapons ban.

photo.author: U.S. Senate Photographic Services; Rebecca Hammel

candidates.name: Jon Husted
candidates.basis: Voted for 2025 reconciliation law; backs Medicaid work requirements, Russia sanctions, school choice; opposes abortion, backs gun rights (liberty mix); sponsored appliance-rule repeal.

photo.file: File:Sen. Jon Husted official portrait, 119th Congress (cropped).jpg
photo.author: United States Senate

candidates.name: Amy Acton
candidates.basis: Pledges abortion access, voucher reform ('public money for public schools'), working-family tax credits, union protections, funded police; opposes transgender girls in girls' sports.

photo.author: Senior Airman Gwendalyn Smith, U.S. Air National Guard

candidates.name: Vivek Ramaswamy
candidates.basis: Plans income-tax phaseout, property-tax cuts, data-center approval pause; backs school choice, mass deportation, fossil fuels, ending Ukraine aid; opposes abortion, backs constitutional carry.

candidates.name: Kevin Hern
candidates.basis: Favors flat tax, work requirements, border wall, defending Israel; opposes climate regulation, net neutrality; abortion and marriage stances offset pro-gun views (liberty).

photo.file: File:Rep. Kevin Hern official photo, 116th congress (cropped).jpg
photo.author: Franmarie Metzler; U.S. House Office of Photography

candidates.name: N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas
candidates.basis: Backs Medicare for All, universal childcare, living wage, abolishing ICE, restoring Roe, codifying marriage equality, stronger Clean Water Act, smaller classes, free school meals.

candidates.name: Mike Mazzei
candidates.basis: Would phase out income tax, cut green-energy and data-center tax breaks, regulate data-center water and power; opposes abortion in all cases (sole liberty evidence).

candidates.name: Cyndi Munson
candidates.basis: Would repeal voucher tax credit, pause new data centers, raise minimum wage, protect Medicaid; liberty: abortion-ban repeal, opposed church stand-your-ground bill.
